title: Covering designs
summary: Minimize k-blocks covering every t-subset, with independent exact verification and one record per (v,k,t). LOCAL proposal; governance pending.

credit.policy: Each accepted record credits whoever found its witness (the record table's provenance), and result packages credit methods and reviews; contributors are listed by name with consent. Preserve source authorship (La Jolla Coverings Repository and its contributors). Disclose AI assistance. No promise of co-authorship or publication.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

requirements.note: Python 3.10+ standard library. Included checks are offline; no solver or GPU required.
